GR_k(W_{2n})=\begin{cases}(R_2(W_{2n})-1)\cdot5^{\frac{k-2}{2}}+1,&\text{if }k\text{ is even},\\2(R_2(W_{2n})-1)\cdot5^{\frac{k-3}{2}}+1,&\text{if }k\text{ is odd}.
\end{cases}
$$
